findings.finding: Four separate class ids exactly: class_ids, classes keys and the supplement frozen_classes all equal {AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN, AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH}; no fifth id is smuggled in variants or prose.

Disjointness tests pass independently: all 6 unordered pairs are declared and, for every pair, every named decisive axis actually differs in value (recomputed from the axes, not read from the separation prose). Separations are descriptor-level and the data-space overlap caveat (Schwarzschild data also solve the scalar system with phi=0) is explicit.

Single-q visibility predicate present in both WCC conclusions: AF-WCC-VAC-GEN defines visibility iff there exist q in I+ and t0 with the tail gamma([t0,T)) in J^-(q) intersect M, and states it is a definition, not an equivalence; AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH spells out the negated tail form for every q,t0. The set-based reading appears only in variant SET and in the VAC disclaimer marking it NOT a class predicate.

Explicit comeager quantifier in all four class conclusions, bound before the data: the three vacuum classes use 'there is a comeager set G_{s,delta} of data such that for every data set in G_{s,delta}' (set bound before the data variable), and the scalar class says 'chosen before and independently of the data'.

No C0/C2 merge and no C2 statement smuggled into C0: regularity_token is C2 vs C0 with distinct conclusion_type values; the C0 class excludes C2-only results and routes them to the C2 class; the C2 class rejects C0-only proofs as stronger, never downgraded; X1 forbids C2->C0 and T1 licenses only C0->C2. My normalized merged-regularity scan finds only metalinguistic mentions (revision note 'C2/C0 provenance pointers', the rule that C2 and C0 'must never be merged', and the separation prose), never a class token.

No theorem or counterexample promotion: status=draft_unverified, claims_theorem_status=false, no conclusion.type=theorem, all literature pointers marked unresolved_pending_L0_L1, candidate consequence C1 explicitly not a classification predicate, known_obstruction entries explicitly pointer-only.

Each class carries hypotheses (with machine_checkable and unresolved/owned_by flags where applicable), exclusions, positive and negative test cases, and provenance; both SCC classes carry known_obstruction. The genuinely open items (topology/weighted spaces, C0 definition, genericity notion) are disclosed as owned by F1/F2/L0-L1 rather than silently assumed.

findings.kind: field two readers would disagree on
findings.finding: AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH carries axes.genericity_kind = unresolved and H4 frames the open choice as dense-open versus full-measure, while its conclusion is generic-quantified over a comeager set. Under VOCAB_ALIASES, comeager resolves to the canonical residual_comeager, so a linter bound to the alias registry reads a settled Baire kind where the axis says unresolved. The supplement's axis_registry agrees with 'unresolved' but its scalar_note describes the F0 value as 'provisional', which is not the token F0 carries. Semantics are recoverable from the registry, but F0 alone does not settle whether the scalar class's genericity kind is named; recommend aligning the axis token or stating explicitly that the class-level quantifier is comeager while the topology on the reduced data space remains F1-owned.

findings.kind: field two readers would disagree on
findings.finding: field_vocabulary.genericity_topology has the rule that a generic-quantified claim 'must name genericity_kind AND genericity_topology', but no class axes vector carries a genericity_topology key; only prose (genericity_value_status and H4) records the downstream owner. A linter that reads the axes cannot check the vocabulary's own 'must' rule; add the axis (value unresolved/named_by_F1/named_by_F2) or weaken the rule.

F0's conclusion_type.allowed and the four axes use only the alias spellings (strong_cosmic_censorship_C2/_C0, provisional_baire_residual), while the alias policy says canonical tokens (scc_c2_future_inextendibility / scc_c0_future_inextendibility) must appear in a new canonical artifact; F0 does not cite artifacts/formulation/VOCAB_ALIASES.json. Equivalence is 1:1 so no merge hazard exists, but a linter bound only to F0 sees no path from its allowed list to the canonical tokens the schemas use; add a vocabulary_aliases_ref to F0 or list the canonical tokens first.

The two variants carry explicit, decidable falsifiers, but the four class entries carry no falsifier field. Decidability is nevertheless carried operationally by guards G1-G7, the six disjointness tests, the positive/negative test cases and the 37-case schemas/taxonomy_cases.jsonl corpus (20 planted negative cases with named leak rules), which is why check I is PASS; a per-class falsifier pointer would make the property uniform.
